_comment: Voice IDs are REPLACE_ME until Brian picks them by ear with `labs_pipe voices list`. BRIAN is a placeholder voice for the draft only; the finished episode uses Brian's own recordings dropped into selected/ under the line IDs.

NARRATOR.name: Narrator
NARRATOR.description: Warm, unhurried, a teacher walking you through a place. Forties to sixties. Never slick, never preachy.

READER.name: Scripture reader
READER.description: Plain, slower, clear. Distinct from the narrator so Scripture is never confused with our words. Reads what is written and adds nothing.

BRIAN.name: Brian (placeholder)
BRIAN.description: Placeholder for Brian Clark's own voice. Male, steady, Midwestern, dry. Replace every line with his recording before release.

MAN.name: The man born blind
MAN.description: Young adult male, Jerusalem, a beggar all his life. Inner voice during the walk to Siloam: quiet, counting, listening. Only in imagined scenes.

NEIGHBOUR.name: A neighbour
NEIGHBOUR.description: Any age, on the way up to the Temple, curious and kind. Asks the questions a crowd would ask. Only in an imagined scene.

FATHER.name: The man's father
FATHER.description: Older male, frightened, careful with every word. Only in an imagined scene.

HELPER.name: A man going down to wash
HELPER.description: Adult male, unhurried, practical. On his way down to the pool anyway; offers his arm and says only what a guide needs to say. Only in an imagined scene.
